subject: Mobile Development
title: Over-the-Air Updates
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Over-the-Air Updates.

hook.text: What if you could fix a bug without waiting for app store review?

buildup.text: Some frameworks support hot updates — pushing new code directly to users' devices.

discovery.text: React Native and Flutter can ship JavaScript or Dart patches without a full store release.

twist.text: Apple restricts OTA updates that change app behavior. Violators risk removal from the store.

climax.text: OTA updates offer speed but exist in a gray area between convenience and platform rules.

punchline.text: Fix bugs without the app store — maybe.

quiz.question: What risk do over-the-air updates carry?
options: Apple may remove the app for violating rules
